adjudication_label: batch_1:Thermal conductivity simulation-experiment comparison and artifacts
canonical_question: Is the 'simulated value around 0.765 W/(Km)' decrease consistent across different simulation run times or cell sizes, or is it a single snapshot artifact?

question_variants.question: Why does the experimental value for HfNbTaTiZr (10-17 W/(Km)) differ so significantly from the simulated random alloy value (~0.765 W/(Km) decrease implies ~8 W/(Km)), and does oxygen content explain this?
question_variants.resolution_summary: No grounded answer was selected from the eligible evidence.
source_evidence_spans: This can be compared to experimental results for sintered HfNbTaTiZr with 1 wt.% O content, giving 10-17 W/(Km) between 300 and 1200 K
